title: haraz-climate-analysis: a reproducible CMIP6 hydroclimatic projection pipeline for the Haraz watershed, northern Iran
description: Python pipeline accompanying Rahab-Rajaei & Motiee (2025), 'Hydroclimatic Projections Under CMIP6 SSP Scenarios in the Haraz Watershed, Northern Iran: A Hybrid BiLSTM-BMA Framework with Compound Extreme Event Analysis.' The repository reconstructs a gap-filled daily observational baseline (2000-2020), evaluates six CMIP6 GCMs, downscales them with LARS-WG 8 and Detrended Quantile Mapping (DQM), combines them by Expectation-Maximization Bayesian Model Averaging (BMA), projects streamflow with an autoregressive bidirectional LSTM, and computes SPI/SPEI, ETCCDI extreme, and compound hot-dry indices under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5.
